# Quoting software, built for your trade

Setell turns an email request into a professional quote in seconds — priced the way your trade actually prices — then takes it all the way to an invoice in QuickBooks. Find your trade below.

RFQ-to-invoice quoting for machine shops, fabricators, water-jet & laser cutting.

Quote parts and labor together — priced from your own jobs.

Faster HVAC quotes that lift close rate.

Quote repairs and installs without the desk time.

Quote design, install, and maintenance work fast.

Measured roofing quotes for shingle, metal, and flat — out the same day.

Linear-foot fence quotes with gates, tear-out, and grade priced in.

## Email in. Quote out. Invoice in QuickBooks or Xero.

The same quote-to-cash loop under every trade page — Setell just prices it the way your trade prices.

Step 1

A request comes in

A customer emails an RFQ or a request for a price. Setell reads the email and the scope — no forms to fill in — and pulls up your prior jobs with that customer.

Step 2

You get a quote in your numbers

Setell drafts an itemized quote priced from your own job history. Review and adjust in seconds; when the scope changes, the revision engine re-prices it as a new version instead of a re-quote from scratch.

Step 3

Approve, then invoice

Send a branded quote with a one-click approval link. On approval it becomes an invoice in QuickBooks or Xero automatically, matched to the right customer — no re-keying.

Runs on the books you already keep

## Quoting that lives inside your accounting

Setell doesn’t just export a PDF. It reads your history to price, matches your customers, and writes the invoice back — so quoting and accounting are one loop, not two.

QuickBooks quoting software

Deep, two-way QuickBooks Online sync — customer matching, invoice-on-approval, payment reconciliation, and pricing learned from your QuickBooks history.

The pricing engine learns what you charge from your own jobs and shows its work on every line — so the quote is grounded in your numbers from day one.

### What is quoting software?

Quoting software turns a request for a price into a professional, itemized quote — and in Setell’s case takes it all the way through customer approval to an invoice. Instead of building estimates by hand in a spreadsheet or a Word template, you send a branded quote in seconds, priced the way your trade actually prices.

### Does Setell work with QuickBooks?

Yes — deeply. Setell reads your QuickBooks history to price, matches your existing customers, creates the invoice on approval, and reconciles the payment. It is a two-way sync, not a shallow one-way push. See the QuickBooks quoting software page for the full breakdown.

### Does it work with Xero?

Yes. Approved quotes sync to Xero as invoices, so Xero users get the same quote-to-cash loop. See the Xero quoting software page for details.

### How does it price my quotes?

From your own numbers. When you connect QuickBooks, Setell mines your last 12–24 months of invoices and estimates for pricing signal, so your very first quote is grounded in what you actually charge — not an industry average. It shows its work on every line.

### Which trades is Setell built for?

Machine shops and fabricators, HVAC contractors, general contractors, electricians, plumbers, landscapers, roofers, exterior and fence contractors, and shops that quote aftermarket parts alongside their work. Each trade prices differently, so each page below is built around how that trade actually quotes.

### How fast can I start?

Setell starts free, connects to QuickBooks over secure OAuth, and drafts your first quote in about five minutes — no setup wizard and no training project.
